text: Semiconductor equities advanced sharply across Asia following stronger-than-expected cloud earnings from major U.S. technology firms. SK Hynix gained nearly 30%, Samsung Electronics nearly 27%, TSMC nearly 10%, and the iShares Semiconductor ETF rose more than 8%, reversing losses from earlier in the week.

meta.note: The structural event is the broad repricing of AI-related semiconductor equities across markets; analyst commentary is excluded.

text: The Bank of Japan held its policy interest rate at 1.0% by an 8-1 vote. In its updated outlook, the central bank stated that core inflation is expected to rise clearly above its 2% target during the second half of fiscal 2026 and reaffirmed that it will continue raising policy rates as underlying inflation approahces its objective.

meta.note: The structural event is the official policy decision and updated inflation outlook. Market speculation, intervention reports, and forward-looking analyst commentary are excluded.
